desc:
🤝Build & run a card shop together with your friends!

Welcome to Card Shop Friend, the ultimate multiplayer card-store simulator!
Team up with friends (or make new ones!) to run your own trading card shop — stock shelves, open booster packs, serve customers, and grow your business as a team! 💥

✨ Features:
🤝 Run a Co-op Card Shop — Work together to manage inventory, restock items, and keep customers happy!
🎴 Open Booster Packs — Reveal epic pulls and collect ultra-rare cards!
💰 Buy, Sell, Trade — Cooperate to make smart deals and maximize your shop’s profits!
🛠️ Upgrade Your Store — Expand the shop, unlock new stations, and hire staff to help!
🔥 Work Together, Earn Together — The better your teamwork, the faster your shop grows!

Can your team build the #1 TCG shop in tow

[Update]
- Admin Abuse 
- Hire Employees
